svg.text: Net assessment
What the artefact supports, what it does not, what is still open
1SAR artefact audit · openscientist artefact cdba2c07 · 2026-09-07
protstruct_review · artefact audit 2026-09-07
Supported
✓ The reported R-factors match the agent's round 7
✓ The sulfate edit the report describes was correct
✓ Both H builders agree on every confident flip
✓ The deposited T15 leg reproduces its calibration
✓ gemmi−PHENIX R-work offset passes at +0.0058
Not supported
✗ The archive does not contain the reported model
✗ Round 7's gap is 0.0501 — fails the task's < 0.05
✗ The protein identity — supplied by our prompt
✗ Ion assignments — both on deposited water sites
✗ “T03 settled” and “refinement sound”
Open
Recover or re-run the round-7 model before any claim about the agent's final refinement · fix the
upstream prompt · T02 has no driver · T15 needs a content figure · the T16 swapped mapping is unmeasured
· geometry, waters and data quality are carried from May, not re-measured.
The agent's largest visible failure — a headline number that did not match its own shipped model —
was an artefact-packaging failure. Its real failure was accepting a protein identity the benchmark
handed it without checking the coordinates. This harness made the mirror-image error: it trusted a
filename for five review rounds, and nearly published the accusation.
